# Skawsh

> Skawsh connects customers with trusted local laundry studios for pickup, wash, and delivery. Orders are placed through the Skawsh mobile app (iOS & Android).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Skawsh, how it works, and why to choose us.
- [For Customers](/customer): Download the Skawsh app to schedule pickup and delivery.
- [For Businesses](/business): Partner with Skawsh as a laundry studio.
- [Support](/support): FAQs and contact details for help with orders, payments, and service quality.
- [Download](/download): Smart redirect to the App Store or Google Play.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How Skawsh collects and protects user data.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms-conditions): Terms governing use of Skawsh services.

## Drivers

- [Driver Portal](/drivers): Legal documents for Skawsh drivers.
- [Driver Privacy Policy](/drivers/privacy-policy): Privacy policy for the Skawsh Driver app.
- [Driver Terms & Conditions](/drivers/terms-conditions): Terms for the Skawsh Driver app.
